title: Singapore and Malaysia with Sentosa and Genting
alt: Batu Caves steps and the Murugan statue outside Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
transport: Private airport transfers, a coach crossing to Kuala Lumpur and shared city tours

expert.name: Nisha Rao
expert.quote: Families get both cities in a week here, with the Night Safari in Singapore and the cable car up to Genting in Malaysia.
expert.tip: Do the causeway crossing early in the morning. The queues at Johor grow through the day and you gain a free afternoon in Kuala Lumpur.

summary: Seven days across two countries. Three nights in Singapore with a city tour, the Night Safari and a Sentosa day, then three in Kuala Lumpur with a city tour, the Batu Caves and a day up at Genting Highlands.
included: Included: 3 nights at the ibis Novena in Singapore and 3 nights at the Arenaa Star in Kuala Lumpur, both with breakfast; Singapore half day city tour; Night Safari with return transfers; two way cable car sky pass; Madame Tussauds with a digital photo; Kuala Lumpur half day city tour; Genting Highlands day trip with Batu Caves; 12 private and shared transfers including the crossing to Malaysia.
not_included: Not included: international flights; visa charges; travel insurance; lunches and dinners; the Genting Skyway cable car ticket; attractions not named above; personal expenses.

day_titles.2: City tour and the Night Safari

1: Arrival at Changi Airport and private sedan transfer to the ibis Novena
Check in and take the rest of the day at your own pace
Optional: the Rain Vortex and Canopy Park at Jewel before you leave the airport
Optional: supper at a hawker centre near Novena MRT
2: Breakfast, then shared transfer for the half day city tour
Merlion Park, Marina Bay, the Helix bridge and Chinatown
Afternoon free, then a shared transfer out to Mandai
Night Safari with a tram ride through the park after dark
3: Breakfast, then shared transfer to Mount Faber for the cable car
Two way sky pass across the harbour to Sentosa
Madame Tussauds with the Spirit of Singapore boat ride
Return shared transfer to the hotel in the evening
4: Breakfast, check out and an early coach transfer across the causeway
Border formalities at Johor, then on to Kuala Lumpur
Check in at the Arenaa Star and a free afternoon in Bukit Bintang
Optional: the fountain show below the Petronas Towers
5: Breakfast, then shared transfer for the half day city tour
The King's Palace gates, the National Monument and Merdeka Square
The old railway station, Little India and the central market
Afternoon free for the malls or Jalan Alor food street
6: Breakfast, then shared transfer towards the hills
Batu Caves with its 272 painted steps and the cave temple inside
On up to Genting Highlands for the plateau, the theme park and the casino floor
Return to Kuala Lumpur in the evening
7: Private sedan transfer to Kuala Lumpur airport for your flight home
